title: Open/proper factorization of the chosen compact-support compositor
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X to Y separated finite type between Noetherian schemes, and c=(j,q) a compactification with the indicated chosen compactifications. The product of the chosen open comparison [def-pur-graph-chosen-open-comparison], the chosen proper comparison [def-pur-graph-chosen-proper-comparison], and the model-to-chosen map t_c equals the compact-support compositor F_j F_q to F_jq followed by congruence c.comm inverse [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

source.place: Tags 0F7B (proper/quasi-finite interchange), 0F7F (change of base), 0F7I and 0F7J (composition); proper/open tower in parent steps 1–3. Graph normalization: etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L.

proof.text: Use the triangle with compactifications ofIsOpenImmersion j, ofIsProper q, and c copied along c.comm inverse. Its middle Cartesian square consists of identities. Apply the every-triangle compositor equation; normalize exchange by the identity-open adjunction law and the open and proper unit laws. Naturality and the refinement cocycle give exactly the stated model-to-chosen comparison. All maps are defined for empty and identity opens.

theorem graph_compactification_factorization
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f] (c : Compactification f)
    [QuasiCompact c.i] [HasCompactification c.i] [HasCompactification (c.i ≫ c.g)] :
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenOpenComparison A c.i)
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory
        (graphChosenProperComparison A c.g) ≪≫ rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c =
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A c.i c.g ≪≫
        unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A c.comm.symm
